issue.title: test_updates_pane_sase_update_confirm_executes_and_refreshes times out on a 5s wait_for under the full parallel lane, passes serially
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY: closed phase beads sase-qn.3 (2026-08-19T01:30:03Z) and sase-qn.5
(2026-08-19T02:31:10Z) of epic sase-qn, each of which recorded it independently as a
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; routed here by the sase-qn land agent.

NODE:
tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_sase_update.py::test_updates_pane_sase_update_confirm_executes_and_refreshes

OBSERVED: fails only under the escalated full-suite parallel lane, on a `wait_for()`
that times out after 5s. Serial isolated reruns passed both times it was reported
(16.75s under sase-qn.3, 1.33s under sase-qn.5). The host-local selection-health record
store holds six full-run records naming this node, spanning 2026-08-16 through
2026-08-19 across distinct workspaces and heads (85c09a886472, 7beaf2ac768a x3,
42a81937b9de, 17592d904366).

NOT CAUSED BY sase-qn: the test stubs the catalog through `_patch_catalog_recording`, so
none of the epic's catalog fetch/enrich/render changes reach this path.

CURRENT GATE STATE: the node is NOT in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, and
`tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake` does not currently classify it as exceeding
the baseline (12 current, 25 allowed). So this is a live intermittent failure that the
gate has not yet promoted, not a gate blocker.

SHAPE: the familiar CPU-contention timing sensitivity in this suite — a bounded wait
that is generous when a worker has a core to itself and too tight when 14 workers share
the box.

SCOPE: re-measure first (`just test-contention` on this node, and re-read the
selection-health records for later failures). Then prefer awaiting the actual
mount/message-pump event over lengthening the deadline; the repo's
`tools/check_test_wait_helpers` policy exists to discourage attempt-bounded pause loops.
Do not simply add the node to tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt — that file is debt
to remove, and this node has not earned an entry.

VERIFICATION: repeated `just test-contention` runs on the node with no red repeats, plus
`just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` clean.

flake-baseline gate's bar and not in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt.
